topic: Visual Design Systems, Typography, Color, and Accessibility
learningObjectives: Apply typography and visual hierarchy principles to interface design.
Choose colors and spacing that support usability and consistency.
Identify accessibility considerations for digital interfaces.

activities.title: Visual Hierarchy Explorer
activities.instruction: Adjust the hierarchy level and observe how visual emphasis changes.

content.concept: Visual hierarchy guides attention using size, weight, spacing, contrast, position, and grouping. Stronger emphasis should normally be reserved for more important information.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Typography Match
activities.instruction: Choose the typography treatment that best supports the stated interface purpose.

content.concept: Typography affects readability, hierarchy, tone, and consistency. Headings typically use stronger emphasis than supporting body text, while body text prioritizes comfortable reading.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Large, bold heading with smaller regular body text
Same size and weight for every piece of text
config.answer: Large, bold heading with smaller regular body text

activities.title: Color Accessibility Explorer
activities.instruction: Explore color choices that improve readability and accessibility.

content.concept: Accessible color design requires sufficient contrast and should not rely on color alone to communicate important information. Text, controls, and status indicators need distinguishable visual treatment.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Dark text on a light background with an additional icon for error state
Light gray text on a white background with red color as the only error indicator
config.answer: Dark text on a light background with an additional icon for error state

activities.title: Design System Builder
activities.instruction: Compose the core parts of a reusable design system.

content.concept: A design system combines reusable visual tokens, components, and usage rules to maintain consistency across screens and products.
